positive_snippets:
We had a good experience at this hotel. Our family stayed for 5 days and everything went smoothly. The complimentary breakfast was nice, drinking water was provided free of cost throughout our stay. Hot showers were available 24/7. Special thanks to Mr. Sachin and the staff for being so attentive and prompt in fulfilling our requests. Initially, the bedsheets provided were not up to the mark, but when we asked for a change, they immediately replaced them without any hesitation.
Overall, the service was good, and the staff were courteous and helpful. We truly would recommend this hotel to others.
negative_snippets:
The room we stayed in looked like hadn't been dusted for months. It was stinking and for the amount they charged was so tiny.

Also the location was so secluded and between an industrial area. The mentioned area on maps is far from the hotel

The amenities was pathetic, they gave us used bathroom slippers and the floor was really dirty.

Would not recommend at all at such a price, there are far better hotels available at the same prices.
